entities.name: Q6G099 phosphomethylpyrimidine synthase
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference Q6G099 from Bartonella quintana is an exact 100%-identity, full-length sequence match to the 588-aa query.
Annotated as EC 4.1.99.17; uses a radical SAM mechanism and a [4Fe-4S] cluster to synthesize the hydroxymethylpyrimidine-phosphate moiety of thiamine from AIR.
Reference annotation reports homodimeric subunit organization.

entities.name: AIR to HMP-P synthesis
observations: Rhea RHEA:24840: 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)imidazole + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 4-amino-2-methyl-5-(phosphooxymethyl)pyrimidine + CO + 5'-deoxyadenosine + formate + L-methionine + 3 H(+).
